headlines.headline: CMHC: Ontario Mortgage Delinquencies Pass National Average for First Time Since 2012 — Toronto +60% YoY to 0.24%
headlines.driver: For ZEB.TO: Negative but contained — first breach since 2012 signals geographically concentrated credit stress in Toronto condos, keeping performing-loan PCL elevated and capping ZEB's P/E expansion; offset is 58-62% GTA LTV cushion keeps actual losses ~7 bps, so ZEB's 11% Big Six earnings beat still holds, just with higher provision drag.

headlines.headline: Royal Bank of Canada Reports Q3 2026: Net Income $6.0B, Up 11% YoY on Wealth & Capital Markets Strength, PCL 36 bps
headlines.driver: For ZEB.TO: Positive — RBC's $6.0B (+11%) on wealth/capital-markets strength is 1/6 of ZEB; 36 bps PCL with 13% pre-provision growth shows Big Six can grow through credit normalization. Lifts ZEB's equal-weight earnings power and justifies 13.5% CET1.

headlines.headline: TD Bank Group Q3 2026: Adjusted EPS $2.77 (+26% YoY), Net Income $4.67B, Revenue Growth Outpaces Expenses
headlines.driver: For ZEB.TO: Positive — TD's +26% EPS beat (+$0.30 vs consensus) on NII + fees is the biggest single contributor to ZEB's 1-day +0.16% vs HFIN -0.81% divergence on Aug 27; shows dispersion inside equal-weight is stock-specific, not sector.

headlines.headline: BMO Mortgage Delinquencies Climb to 0.56% as Residential Portfolio Grows to $164.2B
headlines.driver: For ZEB.TO: Negative — BMO's 0.56% 90+ rate (vs 0.37% yoy) is highest among Big Six and drags ZEB equally despite BMO's 1/6 weight; signals loan growth (+$2.1B qoq) not yet translating to credit improvement, keeps ZEB's sector PCL floor elevated.

headlines.headline: CIBC Mortgage Delinquencies Rise to 0.51%, but Losses Remain Low on 58% LTV Cushion — GTA 0.66%
headlines.driver: For ZEB.TO: Positive on loss, negative on provision — 58% LTV (GTA 62%) cushions loss-given-default to 7 bps, so ZEB's book value holds; but GTA 0.66% delinquency forces CIBC to keep performing provisions, muting ZEB's EPS leverage.

headlines.headline: Mortgage Stress Builds in Ontario and B.C.: Balance-Level Delinquency 0.41% in Ontario, +10 bps YoY
headlines.driver: For ZEB.TO: Negative concentration — Ontario 0.41% balance delinquency (+10 bps) vs national 0.31% shows stress in larger mortgages — exactly ZEB's Big Six GTA exposure. Explains why ZEB's breadth was 1 up /10 down on Aug 28 despite headline beat.

headlines.headline: Canada's Big Six Beat Q3 Estimates on Capital Markets Strength Despite Trade Uncertainty
headlines.driver: For ZEB.TO: Positive breadth — all six beat on pre-provision earnings (RBC +13%, CIBC +20% PPPT) proves oligopoly pricing power; ZEB benefits equally vs cap-weighted TSX, but market faded beat (TSX +0.06%) as priced in — flow, not beat, drove ZEB's 52-week high in July.

headlines.headline: Residential Mortgage Industry Report Spring 2026: National 90+ Day Delinquency 0.24% vs 0.21% YoY, Toronto +45%
headlines.driver: For ZEB.TO: Negative outlier — National 0.24% highest since Q1-2021, Toronto +45% is the driver of Ontario's breach; for ZEB it means GTA-weighted provisions will stay above national, capping re-rating until delinquency peaks, but still low vs 1990 levels so no capital raise risk.
